name.description: New name for the memory block.

content.description: Updated content of the memory block.

injection_mode.description: Where memory content is injected. 'system_prompt' adds it to the LLM system prompt; 'user_instruction' prepends it to the user message; 'agent_file' makes it only available as AGENTS.md in agent mode; 'agent_tool' exposes content lazily via the read_memory_block / update_memory_block tools (no pre-injection).

access_mode.description: Controls whether the LLM/agent can read the memory, write to it, or both.

max_content_length.description: Maximum number of characters allowed in memory content. Set to 0 for unlimited.
